Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(dal): requireApiItemCapability resolution is explicit, not op-derived (review)

PR3a review (security): findByIdIncludingDeleted was applied to ALL ops — a read/edit op
routed through the wrapper would return a soft-deleted item (200) instead of 404. Add an
explicit includeDeleted opt-in (default false → findById, matching pre-pv9 GET behavior);
lifecycle callers (restore/purge/remove-from-sorts) pass includeDeleted:true. Tested both modes.

Refs: purses-89g

* feat(db): 0006 role reconcile + CHECK constraint (additive, purses-crt)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): update repo interfaces + pin-flip tests to match T1 flag-stripping

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(authz): accept idempotency via onConflictDoNothing + null-email guard + schema/snapshot cleanup (purses-8zcc, purses-crt)

F1: accept double-accept idempotency was broken. The membership insert was a
create()+try/catch that string-matched the 23505 unique violation, then continued
the invitation UPDATE in the SAME postgres-js transaction. A query error inside a
no-savepoint tx poisons it (postgres-js latches the error and rolls back at scope
end), so the follow-up update + COMMIT rolled back → 500, invitation stuck pending.
Fix per spec §5.3: add MembershipRepository.createIfAbsent (onConflictDoNothing on
the (collection_id, user_id) unique index) — no error is raised on conflict, so the
tx is never poisoned. Removed the fragile string-match catch entirely. Added a
genuine conflict-path test (member pre-exists on a still-pending invitation → one
accept → 200, accepted, exactly 1 membership) that is RED on the old code (500).

F3a: guard nullable dbUser.email before normalizing — a null email is a clean 403,
not a 500 on .trim().

F3b: strip the 8 inert flag fields from UpdateInvitationSchema (now empty), matching
the member-side cleanup — a PATCH flag is stripped (200), not an asymmetric 400.

F2: 0006_snapshot.json had id == 0005's id and prevId == 0004's id (verbatim copy).
Gave it a fresh id and set prevId to 0005's id so future drizzle-kit generate chains.

F5: extracted normalizeEmail() helper; used on both the invitation-create write side
and the accept compare side so they can't drift.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* docs(authz): role model core + accept membership (pv9 PR3) — API.md + ARCHITECTURE decision 17

Refs: purses-crt, purses-89g, purses-8zcc
